pathway: Spindle assembly checkpoint (mitotic checkpoint complex, kinetochore-microtubule attachment)

seeds.gene_source: MVA genes (BUB1B, CEP57, TRIP13, CENATAC, SLF2, SMC5, MAD1L1) and core checkpoint components; documented in docs/mechanism_screen.md

hypothesis_note: Biallelic status is a hypothesis: the phase of the two BUB1B variants is not resolved. The effect of p.Asn1002Lys is uncertain.
weight_note: Author's convention: 1.0 for the primary mechanism (pathogenic variant with matching phenotype); 0.5 for downstream consequences (hypotheses).
